elations","rel:xiangyun_weiruolan","status"]}]},"schema_version":1}},"previous_ending":{"selection":"LAST_THREE_PARAGRAPHS","text":"雪雁忙道：“里头夹着姑娘才改过的诗稿。”紫鹃听见，抬头道：“给我罢。”李纨便递给她。紫鹃接过，也不翻看，只把那薄薄的诗稿夹重新塞好，抱在怀里坐了一刻，才起身收进黛玉素日放诗稿的小匣中，却没有上锁。外头又有婆子进来问：“这里可还有什么要取的？太太那边等回话。”\n\n紫鹃看了看屋内，像要想一想，又像什么都想不出来。最后只道：“眼下没有了。”那婆子答应着去了。雪雁见小几上还搁着昨夜那盏药，便伸手要收。紫鹃忽道：“搁着罢。”雪雁停了手。窗纸渐渐发白，竹影也慢慢现出来。那盏药早已冷透，再没有人去温。\n\n\n"},"scenes":[{"contract":{"authority_effect":"NONE","chapter":87,"chapter_plan_ref":"data/planning/chapters/ch87.json","entry_from":null,"entry_state":null,"event_refs":[],"evidence_effect":"NONE","exit_state":null,"function":null,"id":"87-S1","kind":"SCENE_SKELETON","knowledge_event_refs":[],"object_transition_refs":[],"order":1,"order_basis":"SOURCE_LIST_ORDER_NOT_VERIFIED_CHRONOLOGY","participants":null,"required_objects":null,"source_record":{"path":"data/prewrite/v06.json","pointer":"/omitted_scene_plans/6/candidate_scenes/0","ref":"data/prewrite/v06.json#/omitted_scene_plans/6/candidate_scenes/0","sha256":"caaa49d2f61760be27df0c9cbbc00433b6d54999199e08caec8260c8b15287ff","text_sha256":"3ff762aec1ecc0a3f9b87d9d9a3ba7a6d4dc9e86383cc4160bbf9426f6f8b56a","value":{"id":"87-S1","title":"婚议不是一次会议决定"}},"status":"DRAFT_IMPORTED","title":"婚议不是一次会议决定","unresolved":["entry_from","function","participants","required_objects","entry_state","exit_state","event_bindings","object_bindings","knowledge_bindings"]},"entry":null,"path":"data/planning/scenes/87-S1.json","unresolved":"DRAFT_SCENE_NO_EXECUTABLE_STATE_CONTRACT"},{"contract":{"authority_effect":"NONE","chapter":87,"chapter_plan_ref":"data/planning/chapters/ch87.json","entry_from":null,"entry_state":null,"event_refs":[],"evidence_effect":"NONE","exit_state":null,"function":null,"id":"87-S2","kind":"SCENE_SKELETON","knowledge_event_refs":[],"object_transition_refs":[],"order":2,"order_basis":"SOURCE_LIST_ORDER_NOT_VERIFIED_CHRONOLOGY","participants":null,"required_objects":null,"source_record":{"path":"data/prewrite/v06.json","pointer":"/omitt
